summary: Verified Sell page redesign end-to-end. Backend migration correct: /api/page/sell returns 4 benefits in order [Professional valuation/BadgeCheck, Professional photography/Camera, Verified marketing/Megaphone, Dedicated agent support/Headphones]; sections.hero.intro contains 'valuation' with no 'appraisal' anywhere on the page. Frontend /sell renders sell-benefits-kicker 'Why Sell With TREL' and sell-benefits-heading 'What you get when you list with us' both in rgb(13,80,224). All four benefit cards (sell-benefit-0..3) present with 44x44 icon tiles and 20x20 <svg> children (lucide). No emojis. sell-valuation-btn text 'Request a Valuation', bg rgb(13,80,224), text rgb(255,255,255). Click smooth-scrolls without error; sell_form-form present. sell-valuation-subtext exactly 'Get your property valuation within 2–3 days.'. Mobile 375px: benefits grid stacks in single column, all card x=20 identical; Desktop 1440px: 4 distinct x-positions on same y (140/434/728/1022, all y=2126) — 4-column layout confirmed. Admin /admin/content 'Sell page' tab exposes editable icon fields per benefit (data-testids list-benefits-0..3-icon populated with correct icon names); Save works with no errors and revert works. Regression: /sell form submits end-to-end with captcha, sell_form-success shows 'Thank you!... Submit another'. PublicFooter renders in brand blue (#0d50e0). Backend pytest: test_sell_migration.py (3), test_page_content.py (17), test_captcha.py (6), test_map_coords.py (4), test_page_content team-list — 36/36 PASSED.

issues: Pre-existing horizontal overflow (~490px vs 375 viewport) caused by LeadFormPage form inputs (sell_form-name/email/phone/etc.) — NOT caused by the new benefits section. The new benefits section itself has no overflow. Out of scope for the redesign but worth flagging separately.

action_items: (Optional / pre-existing) Address horizontal overflow at 375px on /sell caused by LeadFormPage inputs — inputs render at 470px width inside a 375px viewport. Not introduced by this redesign; separate ticket recommended.
critical_code_review_comments: BenefitIcon defaults to BadgeCheck when name is missing/unknown — good defensive UX for admin free-text entry.
Migration guard in _seed_page_content correctly checks 'free appraisal' prefix so it is idempotent on re-run (won't overwrite user-edited titles).

Sell.jsx line 70 uses document.querySelector with unquoted attribute selector '[data-testid=sell_form-form]' — works because the value has no special chars, but for robustness prefer '[data-testid="sell_form-form"]'.
